entities.summary: The Brühl Palace, also known as the Sandomierski or Ossoliński Palace, was a palatial residence at Piłsudski Square in central Warsaw, Poland. It was one of the largest palaces and one of the finest examples of rococo architecture in pre-World War II Warsaw.
